title: web3telbot
tagline: Web3telbot is our Telegram bot that is integrated with the Metamask SDK and it allows us to send tokens between accounts within the same chat.
description:
The web3telbot project integrates Telegram with the MetaMask SDK. It allows users to send and receive tokens directly within a chat conversation by simply providing their username, transforming Telegram into not just a messaging, but also a cryptocurrency transaction platform. It also allows the user to create transactions to arbitrary address from a private conversation with the bot.  
The bot ensures high security demonstrating the potential of blockchain technology integration into daily digital communication.
how_its_made:
The MetaMask SDK is an integral part of this project. It allows the bot to interact with user's MetaMask wallets. It enables the initiation of transactions and confirmation of token transfers, all while ensuring the user's private keys are securely protected.

The Telegram Bot API is used to create the bot and handle user interactions within the Telegram platform. It enables the bot to receive messages, respond to user commands, allowing for a dynamic and responsive conversation with the user. This makes the process of sending and receiving tokens straightforward and user-friendly.

By combining these two technologies, the web3telbot provides a seamless and secure experience for users to perform cryptocurrency transactions within their Telegram chats.
